title: Add QC sample
purpose: Create a labeled QC sample in an open analytical or preparation batch, then record observations for its analytes.

sections.title: Access and relationship
paragraphs: Only analysts, including administrators with operational access, can create QC samples. A QC sample belongs to one batch and has separate per-test measurement history; it is not a new client field sample. Breadcrumbs and Cancel follow analytical versus preparation batch context. Closed batches cannot gain QC samples.

items.label: QC type
items.description: Required: Method blank, Laboratory control sample, Matrix spike, Matrix spike duplicate, Laboratory duplicate or Calibration verification. The type determines required parent sample and measurement inputs.

items.label: Label
items.description: Required, up to 60 characters, unique within this batch after leading/trailing whitespace is removed. Use a meaningful synthetic-style label such as MB-1.

items.label: Parent sample
items.description: Required for Matrix spike, Matrix spike duplicate and Laboratory duplicate; choose the field sample used from samples represented in this batch. Other QC types require No parent sample. For preparation batches, available samples come from prepared members. A parent already disposed of cannot be used for new QC; preparation cannot precede its collection event.

items.label: Add QC sample
items.description: Create the attributed QC sample and open Record measurements. Adding the sample contributes to configured frequency counts but does not satisfy its required measurements.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to the owning batch without creating QC.

sections.title: Errors and next steps
paragraphs: Errors retain form input. Duplicate labels, closed membership, wrong/missing parent or invalid chronology must be resolved before creation. The laboratory’s configured requirements determine counts; the application does not invent frequencies.
